themes.name: Agentic AI applications
themes.description: Covers AI agents that can perform tasks, make decisions, and interact autonomously in various domains like research, commerce, and software development.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrating with IDEs and development workflows.

themes.name: AI for UX/UI design
themes.description: Explores AI's role in generating, prototyping, editing, and optimizing user interfaces and user experiences.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and tools designed to streamline, automate, and enhance various aspects of research processes.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates user interactions, behaviors, and potential risks associated with AI chatbots, including their impact on thinking and decision-making.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in automating software testing, quality assurance, and performance evaluation.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on how AI can be used to conduct, analyze, or improve the process of usability testing for products and services.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Discusses AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries and extract actionable insights.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Explores how AI analyzes customer data from various sources to derive insights into behavior, sentiment, and preferences.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines the effects of AI on jobs, employment, skills, and the overall labor market.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
